body:
I have experience with many psychedelics, ethocin, psilocin, 4-aco-dmt, DMT, MDMA, mushrooms, LSD, etc.
I had been putting of trying the nBOME series due to many bad things I've heard about ODs and negative unwanted side effects, but I got some 25i-nBOME for free so I had to try it.
T + 1:00 - I began to feel like I'm on 2C-I a little bit.
T + 2:00 - Visuals starting to creep in to my mind. Everything looks like I'm on a 2C, headspace feels clear and unaltered similar to my 2C-I trips.
T + 3:00 - Cannabis deffinantly intesifies the effects, as does nitrous. It was one of my first times combining n2o and psychedelics, it felt like a 'blast off' effect like with DMT, but with less visuals.
T + 4:00 - Very stimulating and euphoric, Looking for stuff that I can't find all around my apartment. I am burning a Jesus candle and it is extremely entertaining and pleasureable to look at.
T + 5:00 - Took more 25i-nBOME Feeling good and not sure what to do. Writing is fun, lots of recreational potential for this. Coming up again, reading about n2o, I had a breakthrough experience combining nitrous with 25i. Having a few thought loops, euphoria building again, feeling alert and healthy mentally and physically.
T + 5:30 - Visuals are strong. Will likely not be able to sleep.
T + 6:30 - I find an item I've been looking for all night.
'Things are weird. Being attatched to the material world does nothing good for me. The physical material realm, the 3rd dimension. I've always been a dweller of the light dimension. The higher realm of pure love information and no fear or density. A vibration so high that it is god, or rivals 'him' IT IS GOD. The dimension exsists. Of light and love, I Belive it is the key to all sorts of abundance and kindness, Spirtual Progression. Any kind of light comes from the 3rd eye, and the dimensions that it brings to light. The dimensions that it shows.
T + 8:00 - Past hour and a half elapsed pretty quickly. I have a strange memory right now. I could probably remember alot of stuff If I tried but my short term memory seems to be affected in a weird way. Can't typically remember what I'm doing or saying. Listening to music is nice. I think my trip is subsiding now, although lingering effects still noticable. The after effects are stimulating and not very visual or interesting. Reminds me of a long trip on 2C-E or 2C-I where you are coming down mindfucked and stimulated ready for it to go away and leave your body, but with less mindfuck. My headspace was unaltered during the whole trip, language was about the same. Perhaps my inhibtions were lowered a bit but that is about it.
I had a pretty good trip, but not sure that I would touch this stuff again. I had fun, but it probably isn't healthy.
